subject: penguins
one_liner: The colony can hear you. Now put it in the right channel.
brand_voice_notes: Dry operational certainty about a colony that has introduced written approval to standing close together. No knowing asides. Specific costs, roles and cold delays.

hero.sub: Rookery puts every squawk, fish request and huddle rotation in a searchable channel. Move toward the warm middle after your thread is resolved.

features.title: A channel for every squawk.
features.blurb: Separate urgent weather from general weather. Our AI moves identical warnings into separate departmental threads.

features.title: Earn your place in the middle.
features.blurb: Request a huddle rotation with a reason, an owner and a second penguin who has read the reason. Warmth follows approval.

features.title: Find the fish conversation.
features.blurb: Search 90 days of fish requests by species, sender or level of implied disappointment. The fish itself remains untracked.

testimonials.quote: We used to all shout at once. We still do, but now I can mark it as read.
testimonials.name: Nell Mercer
testimonials.title: Deputy squawk archivist, East Ice Shelf

testimonials.quote: My request to move three inches inward has an owner now.
testimonials.name: Otto Vale
testimonials.title: Outer-ring associate, rotation 14

testimonials.quote: The fish channel has 46 members and no fish. Engagement has never been higher.
testimonials.name: Mara Bell
testimonials.title: Interim director of krill-adjacent procurement

demo_screen_concept: A colony messaging workspace with three selectable channels (#huddle-rotation, #fish-requests, #general-weather), fake named penguin messages, channel-specific search, a composer that posts locally, and a rotation request panel. Two distinct approvals move one penguin from the outer edge to the warm middle. Progress reads 0 of 2, 1 of 2, 2 of 2. Reset returns the request to its initial state. A clear fictional-demo notice explains no messages are sent. The workspace is explicitly labeled as an Inner circle feature preview regardless of the selected pricing plan. The selected plan is shown separately; choosing Outer edge explains that its rotation requests are manual.

design_direction.style: Organic field-station modernism: mint surfaces, deep teal round sans typography, large nested huddle contours and coral approval stamps. Broad asymmetric fields and soft section cutaways rather than floating SaaS cards.

palette.name: Sea Ice Mint and Huddle Coral

design_direction.archetype: Product-led team collaboration SaaS, adapted to a colony field station. Large statement beside designed huddle campaign, open feature passages, full data-story artwork, customer voices and a joined plan comparison.
design_direction.motion_vocab: 160ms control color transitions; request approvals change a live progress indicator. No ambient motion. Reduced motion disables transitions.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Mint opening: left-aligned headline and CTA occupy five columns, large 4:3 campaign artwork occupies seven. Deep teal curved-bottom field introduces the feature section. Lower explainer is a large composed illustration beside live text. Demo is a three-pane colony communication workspace, with channel navigation, message stream and rotation approval inspector.
design_direction.design_review: Read and parsed the latest seven concepts including recorded brand kits. No tuple collision. Rejected the automatic sky/floating-card pattern and red championship palette: neither expresses a stationary colony. Retained oversized minimal typography, chose Friendly SaaS library type and a custom marine palette. Huddle contours and offset speech openings differ from seed selections, parcel tabs, lightsticks, film frames and deletion bars. The round geometry belongs to heat-sharing, not decorative cards.

brand_kit.identity_rationale: Overlapping speech forms become a compact warm huddle: Slack-like channels meet penguin rotation behavior without a penguin mascot or Slack hash. Organic concentric gaps encode the passage into the center. The identity departs from recent rectangular selection and parcel motifs.

logo.concept: Accepted Gemini direction A: three open teal speech forms encircle a coral speech center. Correctly spelled Rookery wordmark with rounded joins. Direction B rejected because its double speech rings are more generic and less compact at icon size.
logo.clear_space: At least half the visible symbol height at placement, using asset padding plus CSS surrounding space.
logo.placement: Landing navigation and footer; demo chrome; symbol favicon on both pages
logo.review: Inspected accepted raster, actual primary at 250px on mint, icon at 32px and 64px. Wordmark correctly spelled and clear, coral center remains visible. Real alpha knockout, no checkerboard. Inspected both logo candidates before selecting A.

graphic_language.medium: Flat vector-like scientific editorial illustration and integrated typography, with curved teal bands, mint ice and coral warmth.
graphic_language.motif: Open concentric huddle contours with speech-shaped gaps; one coral center indicates approved warmth.
graphic_language.composition: Asymmetric layouts, one dominant huddle object, generous clear margins, few large words. Full compositions preserved with contain sizing.
graphic_language.texture: Subtle stippled print texture inside artwork only; CSS surfaces flat.

tokens.radii: 8px controls; 24px artwork; 48px section cutaways; 999px status tags
tokens.borders: 1px solid var(--line); 2px solid var(--primary) for active states

graphic_plan.purpose: A campaign poster showing a huddle as an elaborate threaded conversation.
A designed data-story of two required approvals admitting one outer-ring penguin to the center.

images.rationale: Reserve four calls for two logo directions and two composed reference-based graphics. No photography: the product is colony bureaucracy, best expressed by designed illustration. Derivatives consume zero generation calls.

items.prompt: Design the actual finished original logo for Rookery, a fictional enterprise channel-messaging product for penguins. Penguin huddles and approved inward rotations meet threaded speech. Exact wordmark text: Rookery. No other text. Original identity, no Slack hash, no stock bird mascot, no initial in a box, no mockup, no presentation board. Flat background #DCEEE7; flat inks #124D48 and small #E96A50 accent. Create a horizontal lockup with a compact custom symbol at LEFT and clearly legible bespoke Rookery wordmark at RIGHT. Symbol must work at 32px. Large clean artwork with generous clear space, crisp silhouette, careful kerning. Direction A: three open rounded speech forms wrap around a small coral warm center, with staggered speech-shaped gaps. A huddle seen from above, abstract and distinctive. Round, confident lowercase-feeling lettering with capital R. Keep symbol separate from lettering.
items.placement: Landing nav and footer; demo chrome
items.verdict: Selected A. Rookery spelled correctly, spacing consistent, nested speech silhouette specific to huddling. Background removed faithfully; full symbol and wordmark retained. Two candidate calls total.
Faithful deterministic export from selected Gemini design.

items.transformation: Crop accepted left symbol, pad square, resize to 128x128
items.placement: Mono variant available; icon favicon on both pages
items.verdict: Faithful deterministic export from selected Gemini design.

items.prompt: The attached image is the APPROVED IDENTITY REFERENCE for Rookery, fictional Slack for penguins. Preserve its exact original Rookery letterforms and nested speech-huddle symbol if shown. Create a finished professional composed graphic artwork, not a photograph, not a UI screenshot, not a mockup. Flat vector-like scientific editorial illustration, deep teal #124D48, sea ice mint #DCEEE7, coral #E96A50, off-white #F4FAF6. Subtle stippled print texture. Generous negative space, bold hierarchy, original art direction. No watermarks, no invented extra text. Purpose: campaign poster about bureaucratic huddle access. Use a sophisticated overhead cut-paper-like huddle of stylized penguins whose layered bodies also read as threaded speech contours. A coral warm center, teal curved outer bodies, one small penguin waiting outside. Design type and illustration together in an asymmetric composition, a large organic huddle fills lower-right, typography in upper-left. Intentional text, supplied verbatim: "All together." and "Awaiting approval." Put the first phrase much larger. Small approved Rookery logo permitted. No other text. The joke must feel like a serious enterprise campaign. Few large words readable on mobile. Preserve whole composition within generous margins.
items.verdict: Accepted first attempt. Exact supplied All together. / Awaiting approval. copy; original composed huddle illustration, distinct lone penguin, logo family retained. Hierarchy reads at 680px and 343px widths.

items.prompt: The attached image is the APPROVED IDENTITY REFERENCE for Rookery, fictional Slack for penguins. Preserve its exact original Rookery letterforms and nested speech-huddle symbol if shown. Create a finished professional composed graphic artwork, not a photograph, not a UI screenshot, not a mockup. Purpose: designed infographic/data-story about admitting one cold outer-ring penguin into the warm huddle after TWO distinct approvals. Build a rich composed editorial illustration: two separate coral approval-seal impressions with checkmarks arranged around an open concentric teal huddle, one penguin in a coral central opening, layered curved speech-shaped routes, carefully composed visual hierarchy. Integrate very large exact typography "2 approvals" and "1 rotation" as the dominant numerical story. The two seals represent the approvals; exactly one highlighted penguin represents the rotation. Generous margins, a few huge labels readable on mobile. All shapes belong to the approved nested-speech identity.
items.verdict: Accepted first attempt. Exact 2 approvals / 1 rotation typography. Two coral seals and one highlighted penguin agree with the demo mechanism. Designed illustrative data story, readable at 680px and 343px widths.
